about: Downtown Uncorked Winebar is at 1551 Greens Prairie Rd, Suite 102, in College Station, owned by Melba Tucker.
Visit College Station calls it a go-to for wine lovers and newcomers alike, with global and local wines, curated flights, craft beer and cocktails. The space is also available for private events.
Customers have given it 4.5 stars across 122 Google reviews.
